review: The House of Spiders: The Index Nursefather Yi Sang, who will be referred to as Index Yi Sang in this review, is an exceptionally strong Poise Sinking Damage Dealer and the first Identity to have a skill with 9 Coins. Index Yi Sang's whole kit is rather lengthy and wordy, which is why we need to talk about his passives first, as a lot is going on. Like other Index Identities, Yi Sang has to follow the Prescript and do certain things in order to accumulate Grace of the Prescript and, like Index Don, to also gain further levels of Unlock, further strengthening him throughout the fight. The Unique parts in Yi Sang’s kit are the “Procuration [Hermes]” status, passive “Oracle Device [Caduceus]” with its 9 weapons associated with that passive and unique to self status “Wound-casing Mask”.
